acceptanceCriteria: In internal/cli/render/deployments.go, normalize the verification status cell to a fixed visual width regardless of content (checkmark, dash, or pending icon)

Ensure displayWidth() and go-pretty agree on column widths by using runewidth consistently
Address column starts at the same position for all rows in list output

make lint passes
make unit-test passes
make integration-test passes
userStories.notes: Root cause: getVerifierStatuses() formatStatus() adds trailing space conditionally for wide characters. The go-pretty table library does its own ANSI-aware width calculation that may disagree with the manual padding. Fix should normalize to fixed width. Key file: internal/cli/render/deployments.go lines 397-449.

acceptanceCriteria: Document icon convention as a comment block in internal/cli/render/helpers.go: green checkmark for inline success, green emoji checkmark for major milestones, red X for inline errors, red emoji X for fatal errors, yellow warning emoji for warnings

userStories.notes: This is a cross-cutting audit story. Check: verify.go uses plain checkmark/X (correct for inline), anvil.go mixes styles, sync.go is fine. The convention is: use the green checkmark character (not emoji) + green color for inline results in command output, use the emoji checkmark for major operations like init/gen. Document this in helpers.go near the existing FormatSuccess/FormatError/FormatWarning functions.
